name: Shree Ganesh Elastoplast Limited
summary: Shree Ganesh Elastoplast Ltd. primarily focuses on the commerce of agricultural products. The company deals in a range of raw farm materials, which include commodities such as unprocessed maize, cotton seed oil cake, cumin (jeera), and castor seed. This enterprise was established on March 28, 1994, and its main offices are located in Ahmedabad, India.
